purpose: Resolve evaluation and nomination details before the 36-state development screen; this is not an executed scorer or result

global_prediction_seal.attempt_selection: first valid completed attempt under the same frozen protocol; never choose by accuracy
global_prediction_seal.score_access: no opposite-source scoring before all registered predictions are sealed
global_prediction_seal.evaluation_execution_registration: freeze scorer source hashes, dependency revisions and passed fixtures before accessing study scores

held_source_metric.primary_endpoint: final depth after native KDP and common five-scale refinement
held_source_metric.secondary_endpoint: native KDP depth multiplied by its sealed adaptation-only global g0, without fitted per-view scales
held_source_metric.pixel_mapping: existing registered half-pixel resize, rounding and nearest-depth duplicate selection
held_source_metric.overlap_exclusion: exclude opposite-source observations at native pixels used by any allowed adaptation observation, including both spatial folds
held_source_metric.aggregation: mean absolute axial error over fixed points per view; equal mean over five views; equal mean over three scenes; directions separate
held_source_metric.invalid_predictions: never remove candidate-dependent pixels; nonfinite or nonpositive held predictions disqualify a candidate; record counts and finite errors
held_source_metric.empty_view: evaluation failure; no automatic denominator change
held_source_metric.endpoint_consistency: validate positive finite g0 and five relative scales; final_depth agrees with scales[:,None,None] * g0 * float64(native_depth) within stated arithmetic tolerance; no candidate-dependent pixel exclusions

nomination.ranking: largest minimum directional gain, rounded to 12 decimal places; then lower total measured runtime across six cases; then smaller numeric arm ID
nomination.detached_arm_wins: negative evidence for the implicit-gradient hypothesis; a new method claim requires the bounded redesign protocol

surface_confirmation.alignment: pinned existing similarity-plus-ICP evaluation; fixed reference masks
surface_confirmation.aggregation: equal scenes within each direction/grid/pose condition
surface_confirmation.additional_baselines: freeze eligible same-input pool before dense scoring; unmatched historical methods are contextual only
surface_confirmation.selected_control: lowest aggregate primary score in the frozen eligible pool; smaller numeric arm ID breaks exact ties among P arms; same control for scene/component/alternate checks

gate_inventory.rule: every cell must satisfy every rental gate; do not average across a failed condition

surface_confirmation.repeat_requirement: positive aggregate paired gain in each repeat and gate cell; disclose same-input execution variation separately from predeclared changed-corruption draws
surface_confirmation.mechanism_requirement: full-gradient benefit over matched detached control beyond repeat variation; a tie invokes the diagnosis/redesign rule

safety_and_scope.publication_test: new scenes and second public dataset, prospectively frozen after development; temporal directions are not independent scenes

supersedes.reason: Clarify metric units of the secondary native endpoint before any scientific run or score; primary metric and gates unchanged
